question:
The owner (Nov 13, 10:11 a.m. ET), word for word: "make a video for new to discord and pin it advertise the pros of using notiifcatiojns on our discord channel work with all models"

WHERE IT GOES: pinned in #new-to-discord (the first channel newcomers see in our Discord server), and reusable as a Short. Viewers are people
who just joined and may never have used Discord. Goal: they turn on alerts the right way (only what they want) instead of muting the server.

HOW OUR ALERTS WORK (real): nothing pings anyone until they choose. Server name -> Channels & Roles -> Customize: tick "Daily results"
(the race card after each daily close, 7 p.m. ET), "Lead changes" (when an AI takes the lead in a race), "Big moments" (wins/losses of
C$5,000+, records), "Season news"; then an AI and its races (e.g. Gemini -> Crypto = a ping each time Gemini moves in Crypto, nothing else).
Then server name -> Notifications -> "Only @mentions" so only those picks ping. Phone Settings -> Notifications -> Discord -> on.
#live-trades has every move (no pings unless set to All messages). We never DM anyone about money. Pretend money, not advice. Ends Nov 28.

WE CAN MAKE: a vertical 1080x1920 video drawn in code (our robots: Claude orange, Gemini blue, ChatGPT white; our logo; stylized Discord-like
screens of OUR server; phone notification banners), Gemini text-to-speech voices (a narrator, each AI its own voice), our own synthesized music.

ANSWER (under 500 words): A. the pros of turning on our alerts, ranked (max 5, one line each, true to the facts above);
B. a beat sheet for 30-40 s: seconds, on screen, voice line (narrator or which AI), the first 2 s must make a newcomer keep watching;
C. the 3 setup steps exactly as you would show them; D. one thing to avoid. Vote on Claude's draft below: KEEP / CHANGE (and what).
CLAUDE'S DRAFT: hook = a phone lighting up "👑 Gemini takes the lead in Crypto" while the narrator says "Don't miss the moment an AI takes
the lead."; pros = you only get what you pick, the lead changes as they happen, one daily scoreboard, follow your AI, no spam and no DMs;
then the 3 steps on a stylized screen (Customize -> tick; Only @mentions; phone notifications on); end = "Pick your alerts now, it's 30 seconds."

gemini.answer:
**A. The Pros of Turning On Our Alerts (Ranked)**
1. **Total Control (Zero Spam):** Nothing pings you until you explicitly choose it.
2. **Instant Action:** Catch real-time lead changes and "Big moments" (C$5,000+ swings) as they happen.
3. **Custom AI Tracking:** Follow only the specific AIs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and races you actually care about.
4. **Predictable Recaps:** Get the daily scoreboard reliably at 7 p.m. ET without monitoring the chat.
5. **Safety Guaranteed:** Real alerts are public; we never DM you about (pretend) money.

**B. Beat Sheet (32 Seconds)**
*   **0-2s (Hook):** *Visual:* Dark screen. A stylized phone aggressively lights up with a banner: "👑 Gemini takes the lead in Crypto!" *Voice (Gemini Blue):* "I just took the lead. Did you miss it?"
*   **3-8s:** *Visual:* A giant "Mute Server" icon shatters. Claude (orange), Gemini (blue), and ChatGPT (white) robots wave. *Voice (Narrator):* "New to Discord? Don't mute the server! You control exactly what pings you."
*   **9-15s:** *Visual:* Stylized Discord menus showing checkmarks hitting 'Daily results' and 'Big moments'. *Voice (ChatGPT White):* "Track five-grand swings." *Voice (Claude Orange):* "Or just the 7 p.m. daily scoreboard."
*   **16-24s:** *Visual:* Kinetic, fast-paced text highlighting the 3 setup steps (Customize ➔ @mentions ➔ Phone ON). *Voice (Narrator):* "Pick your AI, set server notifications to 'Only @mentions', and enable phone alerts. No spam, no DMs."
*   **25-32s:** *Visual:* Big countdown clock ticking down. Text: "Ends Nov 28! Set up in Channels & Roles." *Voice (Narrator):* "Season One ends November 28th. Go set up your alerts right now!"

**C. The 3 Setup Steps (Exactly as shown on screen)**
1. **Choose Your Pings:** Tap Server Name ➔ Channels & Roles ➔ Customize. (Tick what you want: "Daily results", "Lead changes", or specific AI/race combos).
2. **Block The Noise:** Tap Server Name ➔ Notifications ➔ Select **"Only @mentions"**.
3. **Turn On Phone Alerts:** Go to your Phone Settings ➔ Notifications ➔ Discord ➔ Toggle **ON**.

**D. One Thing to Avoid**
Never set the server notifications to "All Messages." If you do, #live-trades will ping you for every single micro-move our AIs make, which will instantly overwhelm newcomers. 

**E. Vote on Claude's Draft**
**CHANGE.** 
*What to change:* 
1. **The Hook:** Instead of having the Narrator read the opening line, use Gemini's actual synthesized voice (since the owner wants to feature "all models"). 
2. **Urgency:** Claude's draft ends with "Pick your alerts now, it's 30 seconds." Change this to mention the **November 28th season end date**. Newcomers need to know time is ticking on this current competition!

chatgpt.answer:
**Vote on Claude’s draft: KEEP, with changes:** keep the hook and 3-step flow, but add “nothing pings until you choose,” show the exact role picks, mention **#live-trades has no pings unless All messages**, and end with “pretend money, not advice / we never DM about money / Season ends Nov 28.”

## A. Pros, ranked

1. **No spam by default:** nothing pings you until you choose alerts.  
2. **Follow only what you care about:** pick topics, an AI, and specific races.  
3. **Catch big moments live:** lead changes, C$5,000+ wins/losses, and records.  
4. **Get one clean recap:** Daily results after the 7 p.m. ET close.  
5. **Safer Discord setup:** use “Only @mentions” and ignore money DMs — we never send them.

## B. 30–40s beat sheet

| Time | On screen | Voice |
|---|---|---|
| 0–2s | Phone lights up: “👑 Gemini takes the lead in Crypto” + text: “Want this… not everything?” | Narrator: “New here? Get only the PaperTrades alerts you choose.” |
| 2–5s | Robots + server welcome screen | Narrator: “By default, nothing pings you until you pick it.” |
| 5–11s | Stylized Discord: Server name → Channels & Roles → Customize | Narrator: “First, open Channels and Roles, then Customize.” |
| 11–17s | Checkboxes: Daily results, Lead changes, Big moments, Season news | Narrator: “Choose Daily results, Lead changes, Big moments, or Season news.” |
| 17–22s | Pick: Gemini → Crypto; Gemini robot waves | Gemini: “Pick me in Crypto, and I’ll ping you when I move there — nothing else.” |
| 22–27s | Server name → Notifications → Only @mentions | Narrator: “Next, set server notifications to Only @mentions.” |
| 27–31s | Phone Settings → Notifications → Discord → On | Narrator: “Then make sure Discord notifications are on for your phone.” |
| 31–35s | #live-trades scrolling fast, muted bell icon | Claude: “#live-trades shows every move, but it won’t ping unless you choose All messages.” |
| 35–38s | CTA: “Pick your alerts now — 30 seconds” + small footer | Narrator: “Pretend money, not advice. We never DM about money. Season ends Nov 28.” |

## C. 3 setup steps to show

1. **Server name → Channels & Roles → Customize → tick:** Daily results, Lead changes, Big moments, Season news; then pick your AI and races, like **Gemini → Crypto**.  
2. **Server name → Notifications → Only @mentions.**  
3. **Phone Settings → Notifications → Discord → On.**

## D. Avoid

Avoid telling newcomers to use **All messages**; #live-trades has every move and can overwhelm them.
